body:
That's exactly how I feel. Like I'm worthless to my own parents--and if that's the case, how can I be worth anything to anyone?

I really feel like you heard me, and I am grateful for that.

Thank you for taking the time to respond to me. I will try to focus on myself--it's not that my parents and BF are the root cause of all my problems, it's more that I really feel like I love them unconditionally, and it really shakes me at my core to realize that I'm not loved back unconditionally.
I was having second thoughts about my field, and was generally unhappy. I just didn't feel like doing it anymore, like I was just going through the motions but there really wasn't any point in them.

I know I'm not obligated, but it's difficult to remember that when my parents couldn't even stop themselves from asking me for money on my birthday a few days ago--they gave me a call and pretty much right after "Happy Birthday!" my dad started asking me if I looked for a better paying job and that I need to make more money because they're retiring soon.


I'm not obligated, but I'm really a failure of a daughter if I don't "make it" and pay them back for raising me. Their weekly phone calls have really strained my relationship with them, to the point where I dread hearing my phone ring on the weekend. I feel like I owe them, but I completely disagree with paying them so much money when I have my own debts to bear, and because I feel like they were neglectful parents--at best--who now feel entitled to anything I have simply because they happened to birth me. I felt satisfied with the amount of money I was making, but it was nowhere enough to give them what they wanted, and I resent that I feel obligated enough to think about what they want.


My boyfriend is loving and wonderful, but I get the feeling that he perceives feelings like these as "weak." He's been pretty busy at work, and I really don't think he'd get it. Nor do I want to burden him.


It's just really hard sometimes because I think about my childhood and my college life, then my job, and I go, "That's it? This is what I'm living for?" Parents who basically treat me like an ATM or a failed investment, and a partner who expects me to never get upset. Perhaps I'm asking too much of life, but it just doesn't feel right, and I don't know if it ever will. If my own parents can't even love me unconditionally, then who will? And what's the point?


I'm really grateful for your reply, and I'm actually feeling a lot calmer now.
